metadata.description: Self-hosted marketplace for the teamwork plugin.

plugins.name: teamwork
plugins.description: Run several Claude Code sessions as a team on one goal. Sizes the team from the work's dependency graph rather than the goal's ambition, gives each member a lane it owns and a boundary enforced by a hook that denies an out-of-lane write, keeps work items in whatever tracker the project already has, parks the run at a point a fresh set of sessions resumes from, and improves its own rules from the friction they caused. Refuses to form a team when one session is the right answer, and keeps the contracts small enough to reload every turn by forbidding them to become a work log.
